t: You're looking at The Tuckshop Tanner, a sculpture by Jessica Wetherly in Archbishop's Park. Wetherly is a British sculptor, born in 1989, and she made this piece. It stands in a park, so it's an artwork you can come across on a walk rather than in a gallery. The title suggests a little scene of school life, a tuckshop, and a nickname for a sixpence. Take a moment to look closely at the details of the carving.
